units.source_text: “早先，我职位还很低微的时候，有一个我所钟情的女子。

en.t: In earlier days, when my rank was still very low, there was a woman I had fallen in love with.

units.source_text: 这女子，就像刚才说的那样，相貌并不特别漂亮。

en.t: This woman, as I just said, was not especially beautiful in appearance.

units.source_text: 少年人重色，我无意娶此人为终身伴侣。

en.t: Young men care about beauty, and I had no intention of taking her as my lifelong wife.

units.source_text: 我一面与此人交往，一面颇觉不能满意，

en.t: While I continued seeing her, I also felt rather unsatisfied,

units.source_text: 又向别处寻花问柳，这女子就嫉妒起来。

en.t: and when I went elsewhere seeking other women, she began to grow jealous.
I was very displeased, and thought to myself:
It would be better if you were a little more generous-hearted,

units.source_text: 如此斤斤计较地怀疑于我，实在讨厌！

en.t: to suspect me with such petty fussing is truly tiresome!
At other times, I would think:

units.source_text: 我身份如此微贱，藐不足数，

en.t: My status is so low and insignificant, hardly worth mentioning,

units.source_text: 而这女子对我绝不看轻，如此重视，

en.t: yet this woman never looks down on me and values me so deeply,
she really has had a hard time of it!

units.source_text: 于是我的行为自然检点起来，不再浮踪浪迹。

en.t: And so my behavior naturally became more restrained, and I no longer wandered about in pursuit of affairs.
